consent.title: Privacy & Consent
consent.intro: Some Shadow features use external (third-party) services to power AI:
consent.bulletDeepgram: Lecture audio is sent to Deepgram to be transcribed into text.
consent.bulletGemini: Images and PDF text are sent to Google Gemini to be described and simplified.
consent.noteLecturer: The audio recording may capture the lecturer's voice — they are also a data subject with a right to privacy. Use this feature respectfully.
consent.noteNoMedical: No medical data or disability records are ever sent to these services — only the audio, images, or files you choose to share.
consent.declineHint: If you don't agree, AI features stay off, and you can turn them on later.
consent.declineLabel: Don't agree — AI features stay off
